title: Amen Clinics Selects mdhub's AI Operating System to Power 11 Clinics Nationwide
summary: Amen Clinics is moving its 11 clinics onto mdhub's AI-first operating system, building on its use of mdhub's AI Clinical Assistant.
body_markdown:
**SAN FRANCISCO, CA** — mdhub, the AI-first operating system for behavioral health, today announced that Amen Clinics has selected mdhub as its new enterprise EHR partner across 11 clinics nationwide.


Founded by psychiatrist Dr. Daniel Amen, Amen Clinics is one of the most recognized names in brain health, serving patients across the United States.


The partnership marks a significant expansion of the organizations' existing relationship. Amen Clinics' clinicians already use mdhub's AI Clinical Assistant to support clinical documentation. Now, Amen Clinics is taking the next step: bringing its clinical, administrative, and financial workflows onto a single AI-first operating system.


## From AI Clinical Assistant to Enterprise Operating System


For decades, healthcare organizations have relied on fragmented systems to manage patient care, scheduling, documentation, billing, and day-to-day operations. Even as AI has improved individual workflows, many organizations still depend on legacy software that was never designed around automation.


mdhub takes a fundamentally different approach.


Rather than adding AI as another layer on top of traditional EHR technology, mdhub brings AI directly into the operating system, connecting clinical and operational workflows in one platform.


For Amen Clinics, this means bringing together scheduling, patient intake, clinical documentation, billing, patient engagement, and enterprise management in one system across all 11 locations. mdhub's AI takes on the work in the background. Clinicians and staff review it and make every decision.


## Built for the Complexity of Enterprise Behavioral Health


Amen Clinics selected mdhub to bring every clinic onto one unified enterprise platform. With every clinic on one system, leadership sees the whole group in one place and can hold the same standards everywhere.


"We've worked with mdhub for years, and their responsiveness, consistently high standards and world-class work earned our trust. Running 11 clinics across the country, we need an EHR partner built for enterprise scale. mdhub is that partner, and their team has built alongside us every step of the way."


Krystle Meyer, Executive Director of Clinic Operations, Amen Clinics


mdhub's implementation team handles the full setup and data migration, working closely with each clinic so patient care continues without interruption. The team also trains Amen's staff, so they can run the system with confidence after go-live.


## A New Generation of Healthcare Operating Systems


The decision reflects a broader shift in how healthcare organizations are thinking about technology: moving beyond point solutions and traditional EHRs toward integrated, AI-first infrastructure.


> "For too long, healthcare organizations have had to adapt their operations to the limitations of their EHR. We believe that should be the other way around.
>
>
> AI gives us the opportunity to rethink how healthcare organizations operate, not just automate individual tasks. Amen Clinics has already experienced what our AI can do for its clinicians. A group of Amen's size needs the right enterprise partner, and we're proud to be that partner. We're excited to take that partnership to the next level and bring an AI-first operating system to their entire organization."
>
>
> **Dominik Middelmann, Co-founder and CEO, mdhub**


For mdhub, the partnership represents another step toward making AI-first infrastructure the foundation for modern behavioral healthcare.


**Learn more about mdhub's AI Operating System at[mdhub.ai](https://www.mdhub.ai/) .**
